messages:
Sara: Heads up — Acme reports their CSV usage export for 2024-05-23 is missing the morning buckets (only rows from 18:00-23:59 UTC present). Dashboard and invoice show full-day usage. Export id exp_20240523_789 attached by customer. Can we triage?
Liam: Customer sent the CSV and invoice screenshot. CSV size looks small compared to usual for that org. They use the file to reconcile monthly bill.
Jess: on it. Assigning to billing/exports. @export-bot can you paste the job metadata for exp_20240523_789?
export-bot: export job exp_20240523_789 completed at 2024-05-24T02:14:22Z. shards=3; status=success; files=[/exports/exp_20240523_789/part-0.csv,/exports/exp_20240523_789/part-1.csv,/exports/exp_20240523_789/part-2.csv]; checksum=sha256:abcd1234
Omar: quick check of raw counts for org acme on 2024-05-23 shows ~12,432 rows ingested. CSV parts combined are ~9,210 rows. ~3.2k rows missing.
Jess: hmm. Any worker errors around day rollover? Could be a midnight-bucket splice bug.
Omar: I see worker-57 restarted at 2024-05-23T04:12:10Z (stacktrace: OOM -> restart). Requeue was triggered for ~5k messages but some acknowledgements might have been lost during compaction. Also saw entries written to a temp path under /exports/tmp/2024-05-23/ that were not atomically moved to final.
Liam: Customer says they downloaded the CSV directly as provided. They want an explanation and a corrected file for reconciliation.
Jess: Two immediate actions: 1) generate a manual CSV from the raw usage table for that org/day and send to customer; 2) investigate why export job omitted rows and plan a re-run/backfill. Escalating to eng-infra for the ingestion/exports pipeline. @eng-infra please look at worker-57 and export finalization logic.
Omar: reproducible query I ran:
```sql
SELECT count(*) FROM usage_raw WHERE org_id='acme' AND DATE(ts)='2024-05-23' AND status='accepted';
```
Result: 12432.
Omar: walking the export parts, part-0 has rows from 00:00-03:59 then a timestamp gap, part-1 starts at 05:00. There's a contiguous gap 04:00-04:59. The temp dir contains a small file with ~3.2k rows that matches the missing interval. Looks like finalizer didn't include temp file.
Jess: probable cause: finalization race during worker restart — temp file not included in manifest. Priority: high for billing reconciliation. Plan: (A) provide manual CSV, (B) backfill export and re-run finalization to produce a corrected CSV, (C) run integrity scan over last 7 days for similar temp files.
Liam: Customer ok with manual CSV/backfill, asked for ETA.
Jess: I'll assemble the manual CSV and share within 2 hours. Omar — can you craft a safe re-run script to include temp paths and verify checksums? Also add an alert rule for failed finalization post-restart.
Omar: will do. Proposed re-run command (dry-run):
```bash
python tools/export_reconcile.py --export-id exp_20240523_789 --dry-run --include-temp
```
Jess: good. Also add a one-off backfill job to ensure invoice won't change unexpectedly — coordinate with finance.
Sara: thanks team. Keep updates here. Liam, please confirm when customer receives manual CSV and whether it's sufficient for reconciliation.
Liam: Sent manual CSV to customer (SFTP link). They confirmed receipt and will compare.
Omar: running reconciliation script now, copying temp file into final manifest, recalculating checksums, then re-uploading corrected CSV to /exports/exp_20240523_789/corrected/
Jess: once upload done, notify customer and finance; mark incident for postmortem and include timeline, root cause, and remediation (change finalizer to do atomic moves and retry on worker restart).
Sara: noted. Thanks — please keep small notes here so support can close with customer.
